pois.name: Mushroom (ASHES vent field)
pois.note: OOI's RS03ASHS platform reference is 45.9337 N, -130.0139 W at 1,552 m; it is used here as the Mushroom marker's reference, not an independently surveyed chimney coordinate. The local grid reads 1,540.1 m. Mushroom is about 4 m tall with fluids over 275 degC. UW describes most ASHES activity within an area 60-80 m across. Individual chimney geometry is a reconstruction.

pois.name: Inferno (ASHES vent field)
pois.note: UW/OOI places Inferno about 10 m from Mushroom without publishing a bearing. This scan marker shares the prop’s 0.00009 degree (~10 m) northward offset. The bearing is authored; the marker snaps to the terrain.

pois.name: Hell, Phoenix and Virgin chimneys
pois.note: Hell, Phoenix and Virgin are documented ASHES chimneys, generally under 4 m tall. Virgin Mound is a separate sub-metre anhydrite spire. This smaller-chimney marker's grouping and offset are authored choices; UW describes most field activity within an area about 60-80 m across.

pois.name: Base of the western caldera wall
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, about 288 m west of Mushroom: the seabed rises here from ~1,540 m to ~1,416 m, a slope consistent with the caldera's western boundary fault -- OOI states ASHES sits 'near the base of the western caldera wall' and 'about 130 m east of the caldera boundary fault' (the exact fault trace itself is not resolved at this tile's ~43-61 m cell size, so this POI marks the rising wall terrain rather than a specific scarp line).
